15ljiyr:210: The iii project translates backend capabilities into three primitives: Worker (participant), Function (capability), Trigger (entry point). The value of this translation is that it unifies concepts originally scattered across "backend services," "tools," "queue consumers," and "Agent frameworks" into the same runtime catalog. The key difference is: a traditional tool list tells the Agent "what tools theoretically exist," while a runtime capability catalog tells the Agent "which workers are alive in the system right now, which functions are callable, and which triggers can be fired."
